For example, the frequency based modulation, we start for a certain time we transmit the zero, so we'll have a certain signal, and then we start transmitting one, we'll have another signal, and so on. Each signal has got a duration, okay? If that signal brings carries one bit, that's the duration of the bit. And if that signal carries one symbol, that's the duration of the symbol. Now, one over the bit duration is the so is the so-called bit rate. Okay? And if you multiply the bit rate by the energy associated with each transmitted bit, you get the power at which that bit is transmitted. Similarly, if you consider the power of transmission and you multiply by the bit duration, so the duration the signal that carries the bit, you get the energy associated with one bit. Simple high school relations between power, time, and energy.
